grammar.pattern: 不知道 / 想问 + 疑问分句
grammar.purpose: Retrieve indirect questions without asserting an answer
grammar.explanation: 我不知道她指谁 embeds the unknown reference. It does not assert that she refers to a specific person. Unlike a direct question, an indirect unknown can occur inside a statement; do not add 吗 mechanically.

examples.py: wǒ bù zhī dào tā zhǐ shéi .
examples.en: I do not know whom she refers to.

examples.zh: 我想问这个模型是谁造的。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn zhè gè mó xíng shì shéi zào de .
examples.en: I want to ask who made this model.

examples.zh: 她还没说什么时候转变的。
examples.py: tā hái méi shuō shén me shí hou zhuǎn biàn de .
examples.en: She has not said when the change happened.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我不知道她指谁，所以一定指老师。
commonMistakes.right: 我不知道她指谁，还要问。
commonMistakes.why: An unknown reference does not identify someone.

grammar.pattern: 看得懂 / 看不懂：字幕再应用
grammar.explanation: 这句看得懂 indicates potential understanding of that sentence, not a claim about every line. 看不清 concerns visual clarity; 看不懂 concerns meaning. A replay may improve clarity without guaranteeing understanding.

examples.zh: 这句看得懂，下一句还不懂。
examples.py: zhè jù kàn de dǒng , xià yī jù hái bù dǒng .
examples.en: I understand this sentence, but not the next.

examples.py: zì tài xiǎo , wǒ kàn bù qīng .
examples.en: The text is too small to see clearly.

examples.zh: 声音调低了，这句还听得清。
examples.py: shēng yīn tiáo dī le , zhè jù hái tīng de qīng .
examples.en: The sound is lowered but this sentence is still audible clearly.

commonMistakes.right: 听得清还不一定理解全部意思。

lines.zh: 把声音调低一点，隔壁已经睡了。
lines.py: bǎ shēng yīn diào dī yī diǎn , gé bì yǐ jīng shuì le .
lines.en: Turn the volume down a little. Our neighbour's already asleep.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 这么低，你听得清吗？
lines.py: zhè me dī , nǐ tīng de qīng ma ?
lines.en: Can you hear it at this volume?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 听得清，可刚才那句话我没听懂。她到底在等谁？
lines.py: tīng de qīng , kě gāng cái nà jù huà wǒ méi tīng dǒng . tā dào dǐ zài děng shéi ?
lines.en: I can hear it, but I didn't understand that line. Who is she waiting for?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她姐姐。前面不是说姐姐的车坏了吗？
lines.py: tā jiě jie . qián miàn bù shì shuō jiě jie de chē huài le ma ?
lines.en: Her sister. Didn't they say earlier that her sister's car broke down?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 哦，我刚才去拿水了，漏了那一句。倒回去看看。
lines.py: ó , wǒ gāng cái qù ná shuǐ le , lòu le nà yī jù . dào huí qù kàn kàn .
lines.en: Oh, I went to get water and missed that line. Let's go back.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 等一下，我先把字幕切换成大一点的字。这样看得清楚。
lines.py: děng yī xià , wǒ xiān bǎ zì mù qiè huàn chéng dà yī diǎn de zì . zhè yàng kàn de qīng chǔ .
lines.en: One second. I'll make the subtitles bigger first. They're easier to read that way.
lines.speaker: b

choices: The subtitles were in another language

reading.title: Look back before deciding
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Follow what happened and explain the people’s choices from the text.

lines.zh: 昨晚我和朋友看一部连续剧。她看过前两集，我是第一次看。
lines.py: zuó wǎn wǒ hé péng you kàn yī bù lián xù jù . tā kàn guò qián liǎng jí , wǒ shì dì yī cì kàn .
lines.en: Last night I watched a drama with a friend. She'd seen the first two episodes; it was my first time.

lines.zh: 开头，一个人抓住门口的牌子，把它转过来，露出背面的地址。
lines.py: kāi tóu , yī gè rén zhuā zhù mén kǒu de pái zi , bǎ tā zhuǎn guò lái , lù chū bèi miàn de dì zhǐ .
lines.en: At the start someone grabs the sign by the door and turns it around, revealing an address on the back.

lines.zh: 我没看清那个地址，就问朋友：这是她要去的地方吗？朋友让我先看下去。
lines.py: wǒ méi kàn qīng nà gè dì zhǐ , jiù wèn péng you : zhè shì tā yào qù de dì fāng ma ? péng you ràng wǒ xiān kàn xià qù .
lines.en: I couldn't make out the address, so I asked whether that was where she was going. My friend told me to keep watching.

lines.zh: 过了一会儿，老师指出信上的日期错了。她马上打电话，叫姐姐别出发。
lines.py: guò le yī huì er , lǎo shī zhǐ chū xìn shàng de rì qī cuò le . tā mǎ shàng dǎ diàn huà , jiào jiě jie bié chū fā .
lines.en: A little later a teacher points out that the date on the letter is wrong. She immediately calls her sister and tells her not to leave.

lines.zh: 这时我才明白，旧地址造成了误会。我倒回开头再看一次，终于把两件事连起来了。
lines.py: zhè shí wǒ cái míng bái , jiù dì zhǐ zào chéng le wù huì . wǒ dào huí kāi tóu zài kàn yī cì , zhōng yú bǎ liǎng jiàn shì lián qǐ lái le .
lines.en: Then I understood: the old address had caused the misunderstanding. I went back to the start and finally connected the two events.

questions.q: Who has seen the first two episodes?

choices: The date on the letter is wrong
questions.answer: The date on the letter is wrong

questions.q: Why does the narrator watch the opening again?
choices: To connect it with the later scene
questions.answer: To connect it with the later scene
